create.name: Michael Lobsang Tenpa
create.bio:
Michael Lobsang Tenpa is a translator of Tibetan Buddhism and a meditation instructor who lived as a monk for more than nine years before returning his vows in 2022 to continue as a lay teacher. He studied Asian regional studies in Moscow and later spent two years at the Rangjung Yeshe Institute in Kathmandu learning Himalayan languages and Buddhist interpretation. He has interpreted for many Tibetan teachers, including the Dalai Lama, Lama Zopa Rinpoche and Mingyur Rinpoche, and has translated books by Alan Wallace and Thubten Chodron into Russian.

Alongside his Buddhist training he qualified as a teacher of Mindfulness-based Mind Training and of Cultivating Emotional Balance, a secular programme drawing on both emotion research and contemplative practice. His teaching returns often to the four immeasurables, love, compassion, joy and equanimity, and to lojong, the Tibetan tradition of mind training. He also works in EcoDharma, which links contemplative practice with care for the natural world. He teaches mainly online in English, with some sessions in Spanish, through long recorded courses on YouTube, guided practices on Insight Timer, essays on his Substack and trainings hosted by Tibet House US. He is also open to invitations to lead workshops, talks and retreats, and to offer mindfulness coaching.

courses.title: Cultivating Emotional Balance: A Full 42-hour Training (Tibet House US, online)
courses.description: Twelve four-hour Saturday sessions online, hosted by Tibet House US, working through the main emotion families alongside the core forms of meditation. Each session mixes short teaching, group exercises, reflection and practice.

free_resources.title: Michael Lobsang Tenpa on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page holds guided practices from the Tibetan tradition, including Tara and loving-kindness meditations, plus talks on Buddhist ideas. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Four Immeasurables – An Intro Course
free_resources.description: A free ten-part video course on YouTube introducing love, compassion, joy and equanimity as a complete path of practice, with explanation and guided meditation.

free_resources.title: Forest of Tenderness (Substack)
free_resources.description: His Substack of essays on contemplative practice, EcoDharma and compassion, open to all readers with optional paid support.

free_resources.title: Cultivating Emotional Balance: guided practices
free_resources.description: A page on his site introducing the Cultivating Emotional Balance programme, with a selection of guided practices from it to try at home.

flags: Works across languages: mostly English, but some YouTube courses are in Spanish (taught in Mexico City) and his books and translations are in Russian only.
Insight Timer lists him in London, but his site gives no base and recent videos are from Mexico City; availability set to worldwide (he teaches online).
Only one paid offering has its own page (a Tibet House US training); other work (workshops, retreats, mindfulness coaching) is by invitation through his contact form.
The open letter on his site is signed with a different legal name; the plan uses his public teaching name only.
All three photos are from the same outdoor shoot; identity is clear.
left_out: Books: his own book 'Radical Tranquility' and his translations are published in Russian only; no amazon.com listing.
Cultivating Emotional Balance 12-hour Basic Training (12 Sep – 3 Oct 2026) and its free introductory session (12 Jul 2026): past.
YouTube 'On Healing the World: Reading the Two Medicine Buddha Sutras' and Insight Timer tracks with 'Medicine Buddha' or 'healing' in the title (medical wording rule).
Spanish-language course 'Meditación en la Tradición Indotibetana' (kept one bilingual video only).
Videos on other channels where he is not the sole speaker (e.g. a non-violence panel with Eve Ekman).
